publication.publisher_or_container: Indira Gandhi National Centre for the Arts / Motilal Banarsidass
publication.edition: Sanskrit text with English translation (2 vols. in 1)

verification.verification_notes: Confirmed Rupa Gosvamin's authorship, the Haberman translation (IGNCA/Motilal Banarsidass, 2003, ISBN 812081861X), and the sakhya-rasa / visrambha definition: affectionate exchange between equals, devoid of reverence and deference, full of love, trust and confidence. Technique/definition described, no text reproduced.

limitations: Sanskrit aesthetic terms (sakhya, visrambha, sthayi-bhava) do not map cleanly onto the English word 'warmth'; the translation is scholarly but interpretive.

copyright.notes: Modern translation copyrighted; original Sanskrit public domain; analytical citation only.
